The operating company and vendor directly providing the **CoSchedule** software product at **coschedule.com** is **CoSchedule, LLC**.

### Supporting Evidence
According to Section 1 (*Acceptance Of The Terms Of Service*) of the official Terms of Service on **coschedule.com**:
> *"The following terms and conditions govern all use of CoSchedule.com and all subsidiary webpages (the “Site”), owned and operated by CoSchedule, LLC (“CoSchedule,” “Us,” “We,” or similar terms)."*
